home:welcome:text: Our site is still under development, products and prices are not real yet, but you can have glance on your future food ordering experience, try it out by adding sandwiches, pizzas or any product to your cart
about:page_content:1: A fast food restaurant providing a variety of delicious sandwiches, pizzas, tacos and much more. Located in the commercial neighborhood in M'saken, we strive to bring quality food and service to our community. Our site is available in several languages, you can modify it using the icon in the navigation bar
about:page_content:2: We are the first to offer online delivery service in M'saken, our goal is to provide a fun unique way to order your favorite meals. We offer to our transporters the best working conditions by providing a mobile app helping them organize the delivery of your orders to reduce waiting time
about:page_content:3: We have a loyalty program available that allows you to win points that you can use to buy promo codes. You earn loyalty points by inviting your friends or when buying certain products, the number of points you can earn are displayed on the product
about:page_content:4: Your earned points are exchangeable for promo codes containing discounts with various amounts on your orders
about:page_content:5: Your feedback is important to us, we would be happy to hear about your experiences with us

import:title: Import from spreadsheets
import:intro: Bring in your cars, clients and the rentals from your notebook at once, from Excel, LibreOffice or Google Sheets. Nothing is saved before you have checked it.
import:step:1: Download the template of each file you need and open it in your spreadsheet.
import:step:2: Keep the first row (the column names), delete the two example rows, and write one row per car, client or rental.
import:step:3: Save it as CSV (in Excel: File > Save as > CSV UTF-8). An .xlsx workbook is not read.
import:step:4: Choose the files here and check them: we fix what we can, and ask you about anything we had to guess.
import:order: Rentals name a car by its plate and a client by their phone: import them with the cars and clients, or after them.
import:again: You can import again at any time: rows already in the app are updated, never doubled.
import:kind:cars:hint: One row per car, from its carte grise.
import:kind:clients:hint: One row per client. Only the name and phone are required.
import:kind:rentals:hint: One row per rental from the notebook. One that is over is saved as returned, one under way as out, a later one as booked.
import:format:plate: As on the carte grise: 245 TU 1234
import:format:vin: The serial number (VIN) on the carte grise
import:format:datetime: A date and time: dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm
import:hint:times: Without a time: the agency's usual pickup or return time.
import:hint:flag: Only for a client you don't want to rent to again.
import:review:hint: Nothing is saved yet. Confirm what we guessed or type the right value, then import.
import:counts: ${new} new · ${updated} updated · ${unchanged} already there · ${rejected} to fix
import:header:guess: Not what that column holds? Rename it in your file as in the template and choose the file again.
import:pending: ${count} guesses to confirm or change first
import:done:rejected: ${count} rows were not imported. Fix them below and import again.
import:error:taken: ${column}: already used by another car or client

landing:hero:title: Your rental notebook, in your pocket.
landing:hero:text: Bookings, handovers with photos, the till and the dates of every paper, for the whole team, on the phone and the computer. Made inside a rental agency in Sousse.
landing:hero:visual: Example: a day written in the notebook, then the same day on the app's Today screen.
landing:start:note: Free up to 4 cars · No card needed · We bring in your notebook for you
landing:cash:title: Every dinar in its place.
landing:cash:text: Payments, deposits and expenses go in one cash book. You see who still owes money, and the till matches at night.
landing:cash:visual: Example: the cash book with a payment, a deposit and an expense, the total in the till, and a client who still owes 150 dinars.
landing:dispute:title: Proof when a car comes back scratched.
landing:dispute:text: Photos of every side at pickup and at return, damage marked on the car, and the contract signed on the phone. The client can even sign from the hotel before arriving.
landing:dispute:visual: Example: a car's outline with a scratch noted at pickup and a new one found at return, four photos, and the client's signature.
landing:dates:title: No paper runs out by surprise.
landing:dates:text: Insurance, technical inspection, vignette and oil changes: the app tells you every morning, before it is too late.
landing:dates:visual: Example: the morning alert with a technical inspection due tomorrow, an insurance ending in 7 days, an oil change and the vignette.
landing:day:title: A day at the agency, with the app
landing:day:1: The phone tells you who leaves and who comes back today, and which papers end soon.
landing:day:2: Leila takes the Polo: four photos, her signature, and the deposit goes in the till.
landing:day:3: A client at the hotel sends their ID card and signs the contract from the link you sent.
landing:day:4: The i10 comes back with a new scratch. The pickup photos show it wasn't there.
landing:day:5: You close the till. The cash book already has the total.
landing:prices:title: Prices by the size of your fleet
landing:prices:text: A year costs ten months. Paid plans start with one month free. No setup fee: we bring in your cars and your clients.
landing:plan:groupe:text: more than 60 cars: ${price} a month plus ${per_car} for each car above 60, paid by the year.
landing:data:title: Your data stays yours
landing:data:text: The first question every agency asks: can the agency down the street see my clients and my prices? No.
landing:data:1:title: Each record belongs to one agency
landing:data:1: Every car, client, contract and payment belongs to one agency. Another agency asking for it gets "not found", as if it didn't exist.
landing:data:2:title: Tested on every screen
landing:data:2: An automatic test signs in as another agency and tries every screen and every action of the app on your records. It must fail everywhere.
landing:data:3:title: Photos behind signed links
landing:data:3: Photos and papers are never in an open folder. Links to your clients' ID cards stop working after one hour.
landing:data:4:title: One agency per account
landing:data:4: Every staff account belongs to one agency. No account and no role sees two agencies.
landing:data:5:title: Saved every day
landing:data:5: The data, photos and papers are backed up every day and each copy is kept 7 days, on Amazon Web Services servers in Paris.
landing:faq:title: Questions
landing:faq:1:a: Yes: Tunisian in Arabic letters, Arabic, Tunisian in Latin letters, French and English. Each person chooses their own.
landing:faq:2:q: On the phone or the computer?
landing:faq:2:a: Both. The whole team shares the same data: the phone at the car, the computer at the counter.
landing:faq:3:q: My rentals are in a notebook or in Excel. Do I start from zero?
landing:faq:3:a: No. Your cars, clients and past rentals come in from a spreadsheet or from the notebook, and we do it for you when you start.
landing:faq:4:q: Can my staff use it without seeing the money?
landing:faq:4:a: Yes. Managers handle bookings and handovers; the cash book and reports stay with the owner. A manager can be kept to one branch, and every change shows who made it.
landing:end:title: Start with your cars today.
